step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an IDP platform. First, a pre-processing Lambda checks an Email Inbox (ThirdParty) and stores incoming documents into S3. Next, documents from S3 interact bidirectionally with AI services in the middle layer: Comprehend, Textract, and SageMaker. A post-processing Lambda consumes results from S3, stores structured data into DynamoDB, and sends low-confidence or unhandled cases to SageMaker Ground Truth for human review.
